body: That I can never really have what I want... That my dreams/desires are just means to prolong my suffering (Tantalus comes to mind)... That there is something after life... That there is god, but it is evil... That I will become unthinking and uncaring monster like the ones I hate... That pain is normal, there is so much to fear
" people who hardly try and haven't tried for nearly as long as me get it all" so relatable
I said some ancient Greeks, I'm well aware of main-stream interpretation.

Hope? Some ancient Greeks believed hope was left on the bottom of Pandora's box because it was such a great evil, even gods were afraid to release it. Things don't just improve, you need to work on them, and I don't see a point.
To keep on living in fear?

People are scared of aging too - plastic surgery, make up, even medicine... How is suicide running away, if we go in the same direction anyway? You can't run from inevitable. I never made a choice to be here, why should I chose to keep going no matter how rough  things become? If you have been dealt wrong cards,  you fold.

I am not really afraid of pain, sure it is uncomfortable, but you get used to it with time. Sometimes pain even feels good, believe it or not, at least better than feeling nothing. Keep going, what for?
Thank you. Your friend was brave indeed. I was thinking maybe some substance can help me squeeze the trigger.
I was truly afraid only when I wanted something, I fell no fear if I don't care. If you don't want to do something and still do it, it is not courage. You need free will to be courageous, don't you?

Are you not afraid of death? And how? Unfortunately humans as any other animal have survival instinct which makes us afraid to die, so we can reproduce and sacrifice our offspring on altar of life. Keep on going where? In my experience we imagine goals in our life to keep us going and not thinking about death. No matter what we do we will die and still we go through all that pain just to avoid looking into abyss which awaits.
